name: moderation.tool
description: Open the mod tool, and see users' info and room info in it.

name: moderation.call_for_help
description: Receive, pick and handle calls for help.

name: moderation.chatlog
description: Read rooms' and users' chat logs.

name: moderation.alert
description: Caution and alert users from the mod tool.

name: moderation.kick
description: Kick users from the hotel from the mod tool.

name: moderation.ban
description: Ban users from the mod tool.

name: moderation.room_alert
description: Alert a whole room from the mod tool.

name: moderation.room_kick
description: Kick a whole room from the mod tool.

name: navigator.staff_pick
description: Make a room a staff pick.

name: navigator.staff_categories
description: Put a room in a staff-only navigator category.

name: hotel.enter_while_closed
description: Enter and stay while the hotel is closed.

name: calendar.open_any_day
description: Open any day of a campaign calendar.

name: users.classify
description: List the users of a classification hotel wide.

name: chat.staff_styles
description: Use the chat bubbles staff may use without owning them.

name: room.enter_any
description: Enter any room past its door, password, bans and queue.

name: room.manage_any
description: Manage any room as its owner does: settings, furniture, rights, data.

name: room.staff_immunity
description: Never be kicked, banned or muted by a room's own moderation.

name: room.reserved_tags
description: Give rooms the reserved navigator tags.

name: room.ambassador_alert
description: Send the ambassador alert, as ambassadors do.

name: room.import
description: Import a room copied from another hotel (the room copier), furni and all, as a room of one's own.

name: wired.manage_any
description: Read and change any room's wired.

name: wired.give_reward
description: Set up a wired box that hands out badges and furni.

name: group.forum_staff
description: Read and moderate every group forum.

name: group.forum_terminal_any
description: Buy a forum terminal for any group.

name: messenger.follow_anyone
description: Follow anyone into their room, whatever they allow.

name: command.commands
description: :commands - lists the commands one may use.

name: command.about
description: :about - the server, its uptime and who is online.

name: command.sit
description: :sit - sit down where one stands.

name: command.lay
description: :lay - lie down where one stands.

name: command.stand
description: :stand - stand up.

name: command.setmax
description: :setmax <amount> - the room's most visitors (its owner).

name: command.diagonal
description: :diagonal - turn diagonal walking in the room on or off (its owner).

name: command.pickall
description: :pickall - pick up all the furniture one may in the room.

name: command.ejectall
description: :ejectall [username] - send everyone else's furniture home (the room's owner).

name: command.ejectpets
description: :ejectpets - send everyone else's pets home (the room's owner).

name: command.resetscores
description: :resetscores - clear the room's high score boards (the room's owner).

name: command.empty
description: :empty - delete one's furniture inventory, after confirming.

name: command.emptypets
description: :emptypets - delete one's pets inventory, after confirming.

name: command.emptybots
description: :emptybots - delete one's bots inventory, after confirming.

name: command.ha
description: :ha <message> - an alert to everyone online.

name: command.hal
description: :hal <url> <message> - an alert with a link to everyone online.

name: command.sa
description: :sa <message> - an alert to the staff online.

name: command.givebadge
description: :givebadge <username> <badge> - give a player a badge.

name: command.takebadge
description: :takebadge <username> <badge> - take a badge from a player.

name: command.roombadge
description: :roombadge <badge> - give everyone in the room a badge.

name: command.massbadge
description: :massbadge <badge> - give everyone online a badge.

name: command.roomgift
description: :roomgift <item_id> [message] - give everyone in the room a gift of an item.

name: command.massgift
description: :massgift <item_id> [message] - give everyone online a gift of an item.

name: command.giverank
description: :giverank <username> <rank> - set a player's rank, below one's own.

name: command.staffonline
description: :staffonline - the staff online and where they are.

name: command.happyhour
description: :happyhour - start or end a happy hour.

name: command.promoteoffer
description: :promoteoffer <offer_id> - show everyone online a targeted offer.

name: command.filter
description: :filter <word> [replacement] - add a word to the word filter.

name: command.update
description: :update <name> - read again without a restart: catalog, texts, variables, gestures, effects, giftwrapping, wordfilter or permissions.

name: command.give
description: :give <currency> <amount> <username, room or hotel> - give or take currency.

name: command.summon
description: :summon <username> - bring a player to one's room.

name: command.teleport
description: :teleport - walk by teleporting to where one clicks, or walk again.

name: command.gotoroom
description: :gotoroom <room_id> - go to a room.

name: command.follow
description: :follow <username> - go to the room a player is in.

name: command.userinfo
description: :userinfo <username> - a player's account at a glance.

name: command.invisible
description: :invisible - be unseen in rooms one enters, or seen again.

name: command.mute
description: :mute <username> [minutes] - mute a player hotel wide.

name: command.unmute
description: :unmute <username> - unmute a player.

name: command.roommute
description: :roommute - mute the room, or unmute it.

name: command.freeze
description: :freeze <username> - stop a player in the room walking.

name: command.unfreeze
description: :unfreeze <username> - let a player walk again.

name: command.disconnect
description: :disconnect <username> - disconnect a player.

name: command.roomalert
description: :roomalert <message> - an alert to everyone in the room.

name: command.unload
description: :unload - send everyone out and unload the room.

name: command.reloadroom
description: :reloadroom - reload the room, bringing everyone back in.

name: command.makesay
description: :makesay <username> <message> - make a player in the room say something.
